scope: Authored static-art render planning; no runtime, balance, source ownership or existing approval changes
source_recipe_numbers_status: Unbalanced fixtures copied unchanged; units preserve source denomination rules. Not litres, physical stack counts or final game prices.
style: Havenline chunky rounded stylized 3D; blue/orange machinery, warm timber, gray/steel parts, restrained snow on cold surfaces; navy backdrop; no photoreal grit or generic primitive substitutes.

new_machines.name: Coal smelter
new_machines.silhouette: Tall rounded stone-lined melting chamber; blue cool outer panels, orange feed lever, short broad chimney. Low separate coal drawer and higher ore chute. A cast-bar cooling tray exits on the opposite side. Four chunky stone feet, snow only on cold edges.
ports: ore input chute accepting metal only
bar output tray accepting iron_bars only
front worker control and clear reach area

animation_intent.off: Door closed, no feed, dim firebed.
animation_intent.working: Worker tips ore, coal drawer closes, bellows compress, fire brightens, casting lip tips into a mold, bars cool then move to the tray.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Finish only into reserved output capacity; hold completed bars safely, close feed, pause subsequent batches.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Stop feed/bellows, preserve in-flight job custody; visibly bent chute or cracked outer panel with no invisible throughput.

visual_constraints: Not the central camp furnace; separate plot and distinct industrial silhouette.
Do not depict engine, petrol tank, electric grid or steel prerequisite.
Coal drawer, ore inlet and cast outlet must not exchange sides between angles.

new_machines.name: Metal forming and parts bench
new_machines.silhouette: One broad warm-timber workbench with stone footings and blue iron frame. Hand flywheel drives two compact visible rollers; an adjacent screw press has interchangeable mechanical-parts die. Orange handles, guarded drive gears, bar rack at entry, flat sheet tray and compact parts bin at exit.
ports: conveyor couplers on feed and output sides without blocking operator

animation_intent.off: Rollers and screw press stop; selected recipe jig is visible.
animation_intent.working: Sheet mode: crank turns, bar feeds into rollers, a flat sheet exits. Parts mode: bar clamps into parts jig, lever/press stroke forms a part, part enters bin. Only the selected mode consumes stock.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Stop before consuming the next batch if its typed output tray is full.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Handwheel stops, stock remains clamped visibly, broken guard or bent guide communicates failure; repair cannot duplicate reserved inputs.

visual_constraints: One producer with two recipes, not two additional mandatory buildings.
Show both output forms separately; never use a sheet tray full of gears.
No automatic electrical motor or fuel tank as a bootstrap dependency.

new_machines.name: Steel refining forge
new_machines.silhouette: Squat broad insulated forge with heavy rounded stone base, deep blue hood, orange bellows lever and crucible cradle. Iron-bar cradle at entry, separate coal hopper, low dark-steel ingot cooling rack at exit. Visually broader and lower than ore smelter.
ports: front controls and safe work apron

animation_intent.off: Crucible upright, bellows still, dark cooling rack.
animation_intent.working: Bars load, coal feeds, bellows move, crucible tilts through a bounded pour, steel ingot moves to cooling rack.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Hold completed batch in reserved safe output; pause new feed.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Latch/hood visibly damaged, crucible secured, cycle stops and conserved job remains pending.

visual_constraints: Input iron bars plus coal; do not depict raw ore as this current recipe input.
Steel remains a branch for reinforcement, not mandatory before every sheet or part.
No long swords/anvils presented as additional inventory output.

new_machines.name: Vehicle assembly bench
new_machines.silhouette: Wide reinforced blue and timber assembly table on four stone footings with a compact orange gantry hoist, central assembly jig and guarded hand winch. Three separated inbound parts bays, broad output cradle. Show a drive assembly and mobility module as different selectable jobs.
ports: front worker aisle and accessible hoist control

animation_intent.off: Hoist parked, jig empty or reserved work visible.
animation_intent.working: Hoist lowers heavy core into jig, worker fits casing and parts, clamps close and open, finished selected assembly slides into output cradle. Mobility job fits hub/rollers and timber/steel supports rather than silently becoming another engine.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Completed assembly remains in owned cradle; no second job consumes inputs until output space is available.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Hoist safely parked/locked, damaged jig visible, assembly stays owned with no duplicated or lost recipe commit.

visual_constraints: Do not invent rubber, copper, batteries, electronics or a full vehicle as recipe output.

new_machines.name: Manual oil pump
new_machines.silhouette: Compact hand-lever pump on an outside-camp snow-covered stone pad. Broad blue piston cylinder, orange handle, short timber/iron braced mast, visible crank linkage and sealed crude collection drum with a capped hose coupling. No vehicle engine or pumpjack motor.
ports: anchored extraction stem into an eligible crude deposit
detachable drum pickup area and walking return route

animation_intent.off: Handle rests, cylinder still, hose sealed.
animation_intent.working: Worker loads body weight into each full lever stroke; piston linkage reciprocates and sealed drum fill cue advances in step with committed extraction.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Handle locks neutrally when crude collection capacity is full or source unavailable.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Linkage visibly disengages, leak-free capped outlet, extraction stops; deposit and drum ownership remain conserved.

visual_constraints: This is extraction, not conversion of an inventory item into oil.
Outside camp, reachable on foot before owning a truck.
No fuel consumption and no fuel requirement to build first instance.
No duplicate empty-drum inventory, infinite free oil or gas/oil explosion claim.

new_machines.name: Coal-fired fuel refinery
new_machines.silhouette: Compact rounded blue still with short tall distillation vessel, insulated orange heat door over a stone firebox, arcing condenser pipe and shorter sealed collection vessel. Crude-drum coupling at one side, separate coal drawer, distinct clean-fuel can filling bay opposite. Stone blocks separate hot zones from timber edging.
ports: fuel output filling nozzle with can cradle
front controls and manual refuel pickup access

animation_intent.off: Coal door closed, fill valve closed, gauges at rest.
animation_intent.working: Crude valve opens, coal heat glows, bounded condenser/fill indicators move, fuel nozzle fills a closed handled can.
animation_intent.blocked_output: Stop accepting crude/coal before a new batch when no output capacity; keep completed owned fuel in reserved sealed vessel.
animation_intent.jammed_or_damaged: Close intake/fill valves, stop batch, reveal damaged pipe bracket or housing; preserve resources and do not run a fake success loop.

visual_constraints: Inputs crude_oil and coal; output fuel. No mandatory petrol-powered pump.
Clearly separate crude collection drum and clean fuel can using silhouette and symbols, not color alone.
No extra waste/byproduct inventory or real-world petroleum engineering claims.

existing_reuse.reuse: Existing eight-view cooker/processor. Do not redesign. Meat cooking is current design; exact active recipe amounts outside industrial graph.
Existing eight-view saw; optional lumber_mill variant also archived.
Existing quarry machine reference; modern recipe graph calls this stone-to-blocks. Historical extraction appearance alone does not prove the transformation cycle.
Existing cooker/intake plus conveyor fish route. Whole-fish output; do not create mandatory fillet intermediate.
Existing rendered direct wheat-to-bread machine. No mandatory flour item.

common_ports_rule: Manual handoff remains reachable; conveyors are optional typed transfers at designated input/output sockets, not a prerequisite to first use. Bulk delivery preserves individual resource identities and reserved recipe input/output custody.
excluded_new_machine_economies: Separate flour mill and flour inventory
Leather tannery/leather stock; hide currently goes to harness projects directly
Slate-tile production stock; slate has direct construction uses
Gems production machine; premium_gems is optional currency
Relay-component factory; finite project component supply not established as a recipe
Drying racks or species-cut products as new mandatory economy
existing_approval_boundary: Retain original selected render reviews and scores. A historical9.4 or9.8 remains historical, not a newly certified9.9. Current selected-source binding and final gates still apply at integration.
